response.overview: The lives of a child and a father are never truly the same after the loss of a mother. Jauhar, a vocational high school student with a passion for photography, is now trying to get closer to his father, who spends his time isolated in that quiet room.  Only a bowl of warm soup on the table serves as the bond between them. Curiosity and disappointment become the gateway to a conflict between the two.
response.title: Sup Hangat
